# agentconfig.org

> A reference site for configuring AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.
> Covers 13 AI primitives, a scope model, provider comparison, config file locations, and tutorials for
> skills, agent definitions, lifecycle hooks, and MCP tool integrations.

This file provides a table of contents. For complete content, see /llms-full.txt.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://agentconfig.org/): AI primitives reference, interactive file tree, provider comparison matrix
- [Skills Tutorial](https://agentconfig.org/skills): How to create agent skills following the agentskills.io specification
- [Agents Tutorial](https://agentconfig.org/agents): Agent definition files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md)
- [Hooks Tutorial](https://agentconfig.org/hooks): Design, test, and map lifecycle hooks across provider runtimes
- [MCP Tool Integrations](https://agentconfig.org/mcp): Connect AI assistants to external tools via Model Context Protocol
- [Provider Compatibility Profiles](https://agentconfig.org/profiles): Per-provider view of every primitive: support level, implementation, location, and source documentation

## Docs

- [Full site content](/llms-full.txt): Complete content for deep context (recommended for agents)
- [Skills Tutorial content](/skills.md): Skills tutorial with 5 example skills
- [Agents Tutorial content](/agents.md): Agents tutorial with code samples
- [Hooks Tutorial content](/hooks.md): Hooks tutorial with provider tabs, reusable policy logic, and fixture tests
- [MCP Tool Integrations content](/mcp.md): MCP tutorial with configuration examples
- [Provider Compatibility Profiles content](/profiles.md): Provider compatibility profiles generated from the typed primitives model

## Optional

- [agentskills.io specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): The skills format specification
- [AGENTS.md specification](https://agents.md): Open format for guiding coding agents
- [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/latest): Model Context Protocol specification
- [Claude Code memory docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory): Official CLAUDE.md documentation
- [Copilot repository instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-on-github/customize-copilot/add-custom-instructions/add-repository-instructions): GitHub Copilot instruction-file documentation
